typography.fonts_to_use: Playfair Display or Cormorant Garamond for serif headings; Inter or Manrope for sans body.

layouts.panoramica: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 md:gap-8 p-4 md:p-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto
layouts.trova_specialista: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 p-4 md:p-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto
layouts.vetrina_editor: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-8 p-4 md:p-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto items-start

greeting_cover.description: Patient greeting cover, personalized by time of day with next appointment info.
greeting_cover.classes: relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-[#0A192F] text-[#FDFBF7] p-8 md:p-12 col-span-full shadow-lg
greeting_cover.structure: Background image with bg-black/40 overlay to ensure text contrast. H1 serif greeting 'Buongiorno Giulia'. Flex row or elegant badge for 'Prossimo appuntamento'.

in_parole_semplici_box.description: Highlighted box explaining diagnosis/visit in simple terms.
in_parole_semplici_box.classes: col-span-full lg:col-span-8 bg-[#FFF9E6] border border-[#FFE5B4] rounded-3xl p-6 md:p-8 shadow-sm
in_parole_semplici_box.structure: H2 serif 'In parole semplici'. Clean grid or flex layout for 'Diagnosi', 'Cosa fare', 'Quando tornare'. Use Tooltip from shadcn for AI glossary medical terms (dotted underline on terms).

doctor_card.description: Card showing the treating doctor in the patient dashboard.
doctor_card.classes: col-span-full lg:col-span-4 bg-white border border-[#0A192F]/10 rounded-3xl p-6 flex flex-col gap-5 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all
doctor_card.structure: Avatar/Photo (rounded-full w-16 h-16), Name (serif text-xl), Specialty. List of clinics. Action buttons: 'Scrivi' (outline/secondary), 'Prenota' (solid/primary). Subtle text link to Vetrina.

vetrina_pubblica.description: Public doctor showcase page (/medico/:slug) accessible without login.
vetrina_pubblica.structure: Hero section: Clinic cover image (h-64 object-cover). Doctor profile photo overlaps the cover bottom edge. Content: Bio section (serif heading, sans body). Services list in clean cards (service name, duration, optional price).

trova_specialista.classes: bg-white rounded-3xl p-6 border border-[#0A192F]/10 hover:shadow-md transition-all flex flex-col gap-4 group
trova_specialista.structure: Photo, Name (serif), Specialty, City. 'Prenota' button linking to Vetrina. The card itself can be a clickable link to the Vetrina.

vetrina_editor.description: Doctor Area Riservata section for editing their Vetrina.
vetrina_editor.structure: Left column: Editor form (Image uploads for cover/profile using sleek dropzones, bio textarea, dynamic list inputs for services). Right column: Sticky live preview of the public Vetrina wrapped in a 'mock browser' frame.

Smiling female doctor for profile examples

Clean medical room for Vetrina cover

patient_greeting.description: Smiling boy for patient portal greeting cover background

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the UI in Italian as requested.
Use Playfair Display or Cormorant Garamond for headings (font-serif) and Inter or Manrope for body (font-sans).
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='prenota-button', data-testid='vetrina-preview').
Avoid cold, clinical UI. Use generous padding (p-6, p-8), rounded-3xl for main cards, and warm paper tones (bg-[#FDFBF7]).
For the 'In parole semplici' box, use the warm highlight color (bg-[#FFF9E6]) to make it stand out as a friendly, human element.
Implement the Vetrina editor with a sticky live preview on desktop, stacking on mobile.
Use Lucide React for icons with a stroke-width of 1.5 for an elegant look.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical grids where appropriate.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects sparingly; prefer solid warm paper tones for this specific brand to maintain the 'human' feel.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
